services.title: Areas of practice
services.lead: Aesthetic and functional ENT surgery under one roof — the same surgeon from first consultation to the end of recovery.

editorial.title: Reading the change on the patient's own face
editorial.lead: Every nose is planned around its own bone, skin and airway. The cases below are shared with patient consent.

trust.title: Why Op. Dr. İsmail Çevik
trust.item1Body: Aesthetic planning happens without compromising the airway. A nose that looks right but breathes badly is not a successful operation.
trust.item2Body: Bone is shaped with an ultrasonic instrument while the surrounding soft tissue is left intact, which limits bruising and swelling.
trust.item3Body: The first consultation, the operation and every follow-up are handled by the same surgeon, reachable throughout.
trust.item4Body: What will and will not change is discussed plainly before surgery. A result that was never promised cannot disappoint.

about.title: Op. Dr. İsmail Çevik
about.role: Specialist in Ear, Nose and Throat Surgery (ENT)
about.portraitAlt: Portrait of Op. Dr. İsmail Çevik
about.bioLead: I practise ear, nose and throat surgery and rhinoplasty at Gaziantep Özel Hatem Hospital.
about.approachBody: I do not treat nose surgery as a purely cosmetic procedure. Planning that ignores breathing, sleep quality and facial proportion is incomplete. That is why the first consultation takes a while: first what you want, then what your anatomy actually allows.
